title: PostgreSQL Primary Failure
description: The PostgreSQL primary database experienced an ECONNREFUSED error on port 5432, causing a complete outage and halting all payment processing. This affected 50 million daily transactions, resulting in a $10k/minute revenue impact.
root_cause: A misconfiguration in HashiCorp Vault led to incorrect environment variables being injected into the PostgreSQL deployment, causing the connection to fail.
resolution_steps: Restore PostgreSQL primary from a recent backup
Reconfigure Vault to provide correct environment variables
Run health checks to ensure PostgreSQL is accessible
lessons_learned: Implement a more robust Vault configuration validation process to prevent similar issues in the future.

title: Redis Cache Cluster Exhausted Connections

resolution_steps: Scale up Redis cluster to increase max_connections
Implement connection pooling in application code
Verify connection limits and configurations in Grafana dashboard
lessons_learned: Implement dynamic scaling for Redis connections based on traffic to prevent future outages.

title: Elasticsearch Cluster Deadlock on Transactions Table
description: A deadlock was detected on the transactions table in the Elasticsearch cluster, halting all payment processing for 60 minutes and resulting in a revenue loss of $10k per minute.

Optimized transaction logic to prevent future deadlocks

lessons_learned: Implement transaction locking strategies to prevent deadlocks in the Elasticsearch transactions.

title: Elasticsearch Cluster Exceeded Max Connections
